info.name: Metadata Scrubber
info.summary: Remove GPS location, camera details and other hidden metadata from photos, right in Files
info.description:
Photos carry more than pixels. A picture taken on a phone usually records **exactly where it was taken**, the camera's serial number, the time, the software you edited it with, and sometimes a hidden thumbnail or a whole motion-photo video tucked after the image.
**Metadata Scrubber** adds a *Remove metadata* action to the Files app:
- 🔍 **See before you scrub**: a dialog shows what the photo reveals (coordinates, camera, dates, author, …) - 🧽 **Lossless**: the image data is copied byte for byte. No re-encoding, no quality loss - 🧭 **Keeps what matters**: colour profiles and photo orientation are preserved, so nothing turns sideways or changes colour - 🕵️ **Catches hidden extras**: embedded thumbnails, motion-photo videos and HDR gain maps appended after the image - ↩️ **Safe**: the original stays in the file's version history - 📦 **Batch**: select many photos and clean them in one go
Supports JPEG, PNG and WebP. No external tools, services or PHP extensions required.
info.author: Pratik Mahalle
